newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sets Handlowy IPO price at 35 zlotys.
newsitem.headline: Poland sets Handlowy IPO price at 35 zlotys.

text.p: No of Existing Shares: 65,000,000 NOTE: Price for
the 27,859,000-share long-term stable investor tranche has been set separately in talks with the investors. @

It was set at 20 zlotys paid on the day of the transaction plus 11.4 zlotys payable three years after the deal and a conditional premium due in the fourth year and linked to the bank's possible rise in market value.

The stable investors, JP Morgan, Swedbank and Zurich Group, will choose an exact moment at which they would be required to pay 10 percent of an increase in the bank's value over a reference level of $1 billion.
Retail investors will be allotted shares at a special bourse session on June 21. @
Lead Manager: Henry Schroder & Company Ltd
Domestic offer manager: Bank Handlowy brokerage Main Shareholder: state treasury - 100 pct of shares
The offering took place from May 26 to June 16.
